# The Jar That Glows

*One jar of Prudence's powdered golem stone has started to glow on its own. She wants darker stone to compare, and her rival Mirel to see it.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Selsior](../towns/selsior_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Prudence](../npcs/prudence.md) |
| Level | 64 |
| After | [Powdered Golem Stone](../quests/prudence_powdered_golem_stone.md) |

## Objectives

1. Bring 10 [Dark Quarry Stone](../items/dark_quarry_stone.md) (taken)
2. Talk to [Mirel](../npcs/mirel.md)

## Rewards

- 39,830 EXP
- 1,280 mesos
- [Scroll for Shield for DEF 60%](../items/scroll_shield_def.md) x1
- +15 standing with Selsior
- +80 standing with [Prudence](../npcs/prudence.md)
